title: Car accident in New York and its lasting effects
summary: Dejan describes being hit by a car in New York, escaping without broken bones but left with a bad leg and arthritis. He can no longer walk parades but still plays short funerals, and he dislikes drowsy pills.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

Well, I just, uh, my leg been bound me ever since, you know, and I just can't do too much walking like I could before, because I used to love to play a parade. Yeah.
